obligations.binding: Original FamilyIntrinsicDifferentials318.omega q/p and their full top-open sections. Scalars are original Γ(Y,top), not merely R or rational constants.
obligations.name: Objects

obligations.binding: Every global target regular function a and every global target intrinsic differential section s. No localization, dense-open or pointwise restriction.
obligations.name: Coverage

obligations.binding: The only map is the existing IntrinsicDifferentialPullback318.globalSection f p q h. Its map.val.app(top) is the original canonical module morphism into the actual Scheme.Modules pushforward.
obligations.name: Maps

obligations.binding: The exact source scalar is f.appTop a. By the literal definition of pushforward and preimage(top), this is the existing top-open coefficient action, not an independently installed algebra.
obligations.name: Coefficients

obligations.binding: globalSection(a smul s)=f.appTop(a) smul globalSection(s). The proof changes only to the definitionally identical original pushforward module scalar action and applies map_smul of that actual morphism.
obligations.name: Identities

obligations.binding: Both sides are original full global sections. No gluing or field injection is needed or used. This supplies the semilinearity consumer for a separately constructed regular target coefficient.
obligations.name: Local/global

obligations.binding: One bounded strict source check and fresh recursive target audit of 1 declarations under kernel TC; no predecessor rebuild, accepted-cache change or hosted success claim.
